channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ofensiva total: Zema desafia Gilmar e “Canta Direita” ironiza caso Master
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema released a new video in his 'Os Intocáveis' series, expanding criticism of the Supreme Court, the Lula government, and the Banco Master scandal. Simultaneously, the 'Canta Direita' YouTube channel posted two satirical parodies targeting politicians, including references to the Master case. The content reflects a coordinated right-wing offensive against federal institutions and government-linked figures.

item.title: Magno Malta pede convocação da Anvisa ao Senado por caso Ypê
item.description: Senator Magno Malta (PL-ES) requested the summoning of Anvisa's president to explain recent decisions to recall and suspend Ypê products, citing concerns about transparency and proportionality. He emphasized that the request does not challenge the agency's technical competence but aims to strengthen democratic oversight and clarity in administrative decisions with significant impact. Bolsonaro supporters have linked the Anvisa actions to alleged political retaliation without evidence, while TSE data shows the Beira family, owners of Ypê, donated to Bolsonaro's 2022 campaign.

item.title: PM dispersa com violência ato de estudantes da USP, Unesp e Unicamp
item.description: Students from USP, Unesp, and Unicamp held a peaceful protest in front of Unesp’s Reitoria to pressure the rectors’ meeting for better student conditions, increased stipends, and budget adjustments. The Military Police dispersed the demonstration violently using tear gas, rubber bullets, and batons after the meeting was canceled by Unesp’s rectorate. The Public Security Secretariat stated that policing will continue to ensure public order and that any allegations of excesses will be rigorously investigated.

item.title: STF derruba decisão que censurou reportagem sobre Dallagnol
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court overturned a ruling by Paraná's Electoral Justice that had censored a report on the ineligibility of Deltan Dallagnol, former coordinator of the Lava Jato task force. Justice Flávio Dino's decision upheld press freedom, reversing the fine and ban on further publications regarding the matter.

item.title: STF revoga decisão que tirou do ar reportagem sobre inelegibilidade de Dallagnol
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino overturned a decision by Paraná's Electoral Justice that had censored a report on the ineligibility of former Lava Jato prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol, banning further publications and imposing a fine. The ruling was seen as a restriction on press freedom and the right to information.

item.title: Nunes Marques será relator da revisão criminal de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Nunes Marques has been appointed as the rapporteur for the criminal revision of Jair Bolsonaro’s case, in which the former president was sentenced to 27 years and 3 months for attempted coup. The appointment was made via a draw among members of the STF’s 2nd Chamber, as the original conviction came from the 1st Chamber, excluding Justice Luiz Fux who participated in the initial trial. Bolsonaro’s defense argues procedural nullities, including denial of defense and invalid collaboration, seeking his acquittal.

item.title: Copa do Mundo: os nomes garantidos na convocação de Ancelotti
item.description: One month ahead of the 2026 World Cup, Carlo Ancelotti has already confirmed Vinícius Júnior and Danilo in the Brazil squad, while Estevão was ruled out due to injury. Other expected names include Alisson, Ederson, Bento, Marquinhos, Gabriel Magalhães, Léo Pereira, Ibanez, Vitor Reis, and Wesley, with Hugo Souza also under consideration as a backup goalkeeper.

item.title: ‘Débora do batom’ recorre contra decisão de Moraes que suspendeu aplicação da dosimetria
item.description: Lawyers for Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do batom', filed an appeal with the STF against Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to suspend the effects of the Dosimetry Law for those convicted of the January 8 attacks. The defense argues the suspension was unlawful, as no preliminary injunction has been granted in the cases challenging the law, and the statute remains fully valid until a final ruling. Débora was sentenced to 14 years in prison for writing 'perdeu, mané' on the Statue of Justice during the attacks on the seats of the Three Powers.

item.title: AGU recomenda que CCHA suspenda aumento de verbas indenizatórias da advocacia pública
item.description: The Attorney General's Office recommended that the Honorary Advocacy Council suspend increases in health and food allowance benefits for federal public lawyers, in line with a STF ruling from March 25, 2026, which bans the creation or modification of remunerative or indemnity benefits without federal law or judicial decision. The CCHA had previously adopted a 15% increase cap for reimbursement but immediately suspended it following STF decisions on May 7 and 8, 2026, and the AGU's recommendation. The measure ensures that indemnity benefits, though sourced from private sucumbency fees, do not violate the STF's Tema 966 thesis on 'penduricalhos'.

item.title: Petista aciona PGR contra Flávio na Agrishow por propaganda antecipada
item.description: Federal deputy Carlos Zarattini (PT) filed a complaint with the General Prosecutor's Office against São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for alleged premature election campaigning during Agrishow 2026 in Ribeirão Preto. Zarattini claims public resources were used, including the state government’s logo, presence of officials, and official social media broadcasts, along with ‘magic phrases’ deemed electoral by TSE. He references a 2022 precedent and requests investigation under Article 73, I, of Law No. 9.504/97 for misuse of public machinery.

item.title: Lula exibe “dossiê” sobre pandemia contra Bolsonaro
item.description: President Lula displayed a Health Ministry dossier on Bolsonaro's pandemic management, urging militants to distribute it and demanding public identification of those responsible for avoidable deaths. He criticized three of the four Health Ministers of the period and estimated that 400,000 of the 700,000 deaths could have been avoided with minimal care. The document was presented during the signing of the law establishing the National Day in Memory of Covid-19 Victims.

item.title: Nunes Marques é sorteado como relator de pedido de Bolsonaro para anular condenação
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques has been assigned as rapporteur for the criminal revision petition filed by Jair Bolsonaro's lawyers to annul his 27-year-and-3-month sentence for the coup plot. The rapporteurship was drawn among the ministers of the STF's Second Chamber, excluding Luiz Fux, who had previously voted for Bolsonaro's acquittal in the First Chamber. The defense argues a serious judicial error warrants the Supreme Court's rescinding intervention.

item.title: Nunes Marques é sorteado relator de revisão criminal apresentada por Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques was randomly assigned as rapporteur of the criminal revision request filed by Jair Bolsonaro's defense. Nunes Marques was appointed to the Court by Bolsonaro in 2020. The rapporteurship was drawn among members of the Second Turma, excluding Justice Luiz Fux.

item.title: Kassio será relator de revisão pedida por Bolsonaro para anular condenação no STF
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques has been randomly assigned as the rapporteur for the criminal revision request filed by Jair Bolsonaro’s defense to annul his conviction at the Supreme Federal Court (STF). The assignment was made on Monday, November 11, 2026.

item.title: Nunes Marques é sorteado relator de revisão criminal de Jair Bolsonaro no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Nunes Marques has been appointed as rapporteur for Jair Bolsonaro's criminal revision petition, which seeks to annul his 27-year-and-3-month sentence for attempted coup d'état. The defense argues judicial error, procedural irregularities, challenges the First Chamber's jurisdiction, questions the validity of Mauro Cid's testimony, and claims premature final judgment. Marques, appointed by Bolsonaro in 2020, sits in the Second Chamber alongside fellow appointee André Mendonça.

item.title: Trama golpista: Nunes Marques será relator de pedido de anulação de condenação de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro in 2020, has been assigned as rapporteur for the criminal revision petition filed by Bolsonaro's defense, who was sentenced to 27 years and 3 months for attempted coup. The defense seeks annulment of the trial, citing judicial error, nullification of Mauro Cid's plea bargain, and denial of defense rights, arguing the case should have been heard by the full Court.

item.title: Nunes Marques vai relatar pedido de Bolsonaro para anular condenação
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques has been randomly assigned as rapporteur at the STF for the request by Jair Bolsonaro's defense to annul his conviction in the coup plot via criminal review. He will be responsible for analyzing the appeal, which seeks to reassess the sentence after ordinary remedies are exhausted.

item.title: Lula veta uso de estágio como experiência profissional
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva vetoed in full a bill that would have allowed internships to count as professional experience in public sector hiring, stating it undermines the educational nature of internships and is unconstitutional due to centralized regulation by the Presidency, infringing on state and municipal autonomy. Meanwhile, Bill 1.714/2026 is progressing in the Chamber of Deputees, aiming to extend social benefits to interns—such as FGTS, 13th salary, and paid vacation—aligning their rights more closely with CLT standards.

item.title: Fachin fala em “resiliência” diante de ataques ao Judiciário
item.description: The president of the STF and CNJ, Edson Fachin, called for judicial resilience amid unfounded attacks on the Judiciary, describing the current moment as 'agonic modernity' and urging reflection to redefine the role of institutions. He emphasized that the judiciary must combat sluggishness, inequality, and distrust to safeguard citizenship in republican institutions, without idolizing them. The speech follows tensions with the Legislature, particularly over the suspension of the Dosimetria Bill by Alexandre de Moraes, which sparked criticism from lawmakers and led to calls for CPI and impeachment against STF ministers.

item.title: “Nem estou preocupado”, diz Padilha sobre visto dos EUA
item.description: Health Minister Alexandre Padilha said he is not worried about the revocation of his U.S. visa, stressing that his main concern is the low measles vaccination rates in the United States, Mexico, and Canada — host countries of the upcoming World Cup. He criticized the Trump administration’s handling of childhood vaccinations and its stance toward the WHO, warning of a potential U.S. withdrawal from the organization and pressure on other nations to follow suit.

item.title: Deputado do PL pede à CBF convocação de Neymar para Copa do Mundo
item.description: Congressman Hélio Lopes (PL-RR) sent a letter to the Brazilian Football Confederation (CBF) requesting the call-up of Neymar Jr. for the World Cup, describing the player as Brazil’s all-time top scorer and a symbol of talent, creativity, and hope for millions of fans. He stressed that the request carries no intent to interfere technically with the national team’s decisions, which must remain fully autonomous, and framed the letter as a legitimate expression of public sentiment. Lopes, a close ally of former President Jair Bolsonaro, has shown minimal legislative activity in 2026, with no floor speeches and 20 unjustified absences.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que cria dia de homenagem a vítimas da Covid-19
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a law establishing March 12 as National Day of Tribute to Covid-19 Victims, marking the date of Brazil’s first recorded death from the virus in 2020. During the ceremony, Lula sharply criticized former President Jair Bolsonaro for his pandemic response, accusing him of scientific ignorance and appointing unqualified health ministers, while referencing Bolsonaro’s YouTube comments downplaying vaccine urgency. First Lady Janja da Silva became emotional recalling her mother’s death from Covid-19.

item.title: O alerta do presidente do Republicanos a dirigentes que ensaiam ‘traição’
item.description: Marcos Pereira, national president of the Republicans party, warned regional leaders that supporting candidates from other parties in federal deputy slates will be considered betrayal and will not be tolerated. He stressed the need for unity and compliance with the electoral threshold clause, noting that the party, currently with 43 federal deputies, is prepared to remain Brazil’s sixth-largest party but depends on state-level results to access public funding.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula sanciona lei inusitada sobre rótulos de chocolates
item.description: President Lula (PT) has signed a law requiring chocolate manufacturers to disclose the percentage of cocoa on product labels, including chocolate, white chocolate, and similar items. The regulation sets a minimum of 35% cocoa solids for a product to be labeled as chocolate, aiming to increase consumer transparency.

item.title: Janja chora ao lembrar da mãe que morreu de covid-19
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva cried while remembering her mother, Vani Terezinha Ferreira, who died of Covid-19 in 2020, during the signing of the law establishing the National Day in Memory of Covid-19 Victims. She said she had prepared herself to lose her mother to Alzheimer’s, not to the pandemic. President Lula signed the bill authored by deputy Pedro Uczai (PT-SC) and reported by Senator Humberto Costa (PT-PE), which was approved by the Senate in April 2026.

item.title: Crusoé: Janja e Lula botam mortos por Covid no palanque eleitoral
item.description: President Lula and First Lady Janja announced the creation of the National Day in Memory of Covid-19 Victims during an event at the Planalto Palace. The initiative aims to remind the public of Jair Bolsonaro’s management during the pandemic, directly linking the former president to pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. The move is seen as an electoral strategy to hold the opposition accountable for Covid-19 deaths.

item.title: Lula volta a ser cobrado a indicar mulher negra para o STF após rejeição de Messias
item.description: Ten days after the Senate's historic rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, the NGO Educafro sent a manifesto to President Lula urging him to nominate the first Black woman to the Court, seeking to turn the defeat into a historic opportunity for racial and gender diversity in the judiciary.

item.title: Lula, sobre covid-19: a gente precisa começar a dizer o nome das pessoas que participaram disso
item.description: Lula stated that it is necessary to identify and hold accountable those responsible for the mismanagement of the Covid-19 pandemic in Brazil, using the phrase 'to name the culprits'. He argued that individuals who participated in the inadequate handling of the crisis should be named and held responsible.

item.title: Lula critica Bolsonaro por atuação na pandemia e sanciona lei em memória às vítimas da Covid-19
item.description: President Lula signed into law the National Day of Remembrance for Covid-19 Victims, setting March 12 as the symbolic date of Brazil’s first recorded death from the virus. During the ceremony, Lula sharply criticized former President Jair Bolsonaro’s pandemic response, calling it an 'unnecessary sacrifice' and accusing him of spreading misinformation, including promoting unproven treatments like hydroxychloroquine. He urged that those responsible for denialist actions be named and held accountable.

item.title: Futura/Apex aponta empate técnico entre Lula e Flávio no 2º turno
item.description: A poll by Futura Intelligence in partnership with Apex, released on April 11, shows a technical tie between President Lula (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a potential runoff for the 2026 presidential election. Bolsonaro appears numerically ahead of Lula in some scenarios and leads in all tested scenarios where Lula is absent. The survey indicates competitiveness for the Bolsonarist candidate even without Jair Bolsonaro’s candidacy.

item.title: 1 em cada 5 brasileiros diz ter recebido oferta para venda de voto
item.description: An Ipsos-Ipec survey shows 22% of Brazilians have received offers to sell their vote, with the highest rate in the Northeast (32%). The practice is most common in municipal races, particularly for city council (59%) and mayor (43%), involving money (76%), job offers (53%), and food baskets (43%). However, 62% do not know where to report such crimes, and 52% feel unsafe doing so.

item.title: Lula mostra cicatriz de cirurgia de remoção de câncer
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva revealed the scar from a basal cell carcinoma removal surgery on his scalp, performed on April 24 at São Paulo's Hospital Sírio-Libanês, during the signing ceremony of Bill No. 2.120/2022. This was the first time he appeared publicly without the medical-recommended hat following the procedure. Both procedures — the scalp cauterization and a right thumb infiltration for tendinitis — were described as minor, quick, and without subsequent activity restrictions.

item.title: Relator da Dosimetria vê validação da lei até o fim deste mês no STF
item.description: The rapporteur of the dosimetry bill, Paulinho da Força, believes the STF will uphold the law by the end of May, following the suspension of its effects by Minister Alexandre de Moraes due to ADIs filed by left-wing parties. He states that Congress and the PGR will respond in the coming days, and once their positions are submitted, the minister will swiftly bring the case to the plenary for judgment, with hopes of releasing those imprisoned over the January 8 events.

item.title: Janja após bolsonaristas beberem Ypê "contaminado": "Ignorância"
item.description: Brazil's First Lady Janja Lula da Silva criticized Bolsonaro supporters for promoting or consuming Ypê detergent after Anvisa recalled batches due to microbiological contamination risks. She called the behavior 'ignorance' and linked it to pandemic-era disinformation, also referencing the death of a baby from Covid-19 due to unvaccinated parents. The remarks were made during a Palácio do Planalto event honoring Covid-19 victims, where President Lula signed a law establishing the National Day in Memory of Covid-19 Victims.

item.title: Lula aparece em evento com marca de procedimento na cabeça; veja foto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva appeared at an event at the Palácio do Planalto with the visible scar from a medical procedure performed on April 24, when a basal cell carcinoma lesion was removed from his head and a biopsy was conducted. He had been wearing a Panama hat in public since the procedure, but this time appeared without a bandage. He also previously received a corticosteroid injection in his right wrist to treat tendinitis in his right thumb.

item.title: Lula chama Eduardo Bolsonaro de “fujão” em ato sobre a Covid
item.description: President Lula called Eduardo Bolsonaro a 'coward' for remaining in the United States since 2025, accusing him of plotting a coup against Brazil. He also criticized former President Jair Bolsonaro for his handling of the Covid-19 pandemic, citing ignorance, promotion of hydroxychloroquine, and vaccine misinformation, and demanded public accountability for those involved, including former health ministers.

item.title: Novamente acuado, Congresso abre guerra ao Executivo às custas da República
item.description: The National Congress intensified its confrontation with the Executive by blocking Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF—unprecedented in 132 years—while negotiating with the opposition to bury a CPI on Banco Master in exchange for overturning the presidential veto on the Dosimetria Bill, revealing a deal that favors interests tied to Amapá Previdência and exposes the political use of the secret budget and parliamentary commissions.

item.title: Paulinho da Força rebate Flávio sobre “jogo combinado” com Moraes
item.description: Paulinho da Força denied having a 'fixed game' with Minister Alexandre de Moraes during the Dosimetry Bill's congressional process, stating the text was built through broad parliamentary dialogue. The accusation came from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who claimed Moraes interfered in the bill. The Dosimetry Law, which could benefit Jair Bolsonaro and 849 January 8 convicts, was suspended by Moraes pending STF constitutional review.

item.title: Ministro da Saúde se pronuncia sobre ações pró-Ypê nas redes sociais
item.description: Health Minister Alexandre Padilha denied claims of political bias in Anvisa's decision to suspend Ypê products, following social media videos showing improper use — including ingestion — by Bolsonaro supporters. He stressed the measure was technical and aimed at protecting public health, warning against drinking detergents and affirming that Anvisa acts solely to safeguard family health.

item.title: Governo Lula prepara decretos para aumentar rigor sobre redes sociais
item.description: The Lula government is preparing two decrees to tighten regulation of digital platforms in Brazil, set to take effect on the eve of the 2026 election campaign. The first decree will regulate the Marco Civil da Internet, imposing liability for 'systemic failure' in removing illegal content within two hours, overseen by the ANPD. The second targets online misogyny, including rules against 'red pill' pages and protections for women in digital spaces.

item.title: Violência política: medo de agressões por posição política atinge 6 em cada 10 brasileiros
item.description: A Datafolha survey shows that 59.6% of Brazilians fear physical aggression due to their political stance, up from 68% in 2022. The fear is higher among women (65%), lower-income classes D and E (64.2%), and in areas with criminal factions. Despite political violence concerns, the top fear is cybercrime (83.2%), followed by armed robbery.

item.title: A posição de Aécio após Ciro Gomes desistir de candidatura presidencial
item.description: Aécio Neves, national president of the PSDB, confirmed that Ciro Gomes has abandoned his presidential bid and will instead run for governor of Ceará. Aécio praised the decision, stating that a Ceará victory would be significant for the Northeast and Brazil as a whole, and reiterated that the PSDB will continue to debate alternatives to overcome polarization and radicalism hindering a consistent development project.

item.title: Enquete: Neymar deve ir à Copa do Mundo de 2026? Vote
item.description: Neymar suffered a serious ACL injury in October 2023 and has not been called up by Ancelotti, despite appearing in pre-lists for the 2026 World Cup. He will play two matches for Santos before the anticipated call-up on Monday, May 18 at 5 p.m. Brasília time. Though seen as a potential replacement for the injured Estevão, his selection is regarded as unlikely by media reports.

item.title: Festa de posse de Nunes Marques no TSE tem ingresso a R$ 800 e convite a Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, appointed to the STF by Bolsonaro in 2020, invited all former Brazilian presidents, including Jair Bolsonaro and Fernando Collor, to his inauguration party as TSE president on November 12. The attendance of Bolsonaro and Collor depends on STF authorization, as both are under house arrest. The event, with tickets at R$ 800 (including open food and drink), will be held in Brasília and organized by Ajufe, possibly featuring an exclusive musical performance.

item.title: Fachin vai receber parlamentares para tratar da Lei da Dosimetria e aguarda Moraes para definir julgamento
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Minister Edson Fachin will meet with lawmakers to discuss the Dosimetry Law, approved by Congress after the presidential veto was overridden. He awaits Minister Alexandre de Moraes to release the case for scheduling before setting the judgment, respecting the Court’s regular procedure. Moraes has already temporarily suspended the law’s application in cases tied to the January 8 acts, citing the existence of Direct Actions of Unconstitutionality and the need to prevent legal uncertainty.

item.title: Além de Bolsonaro, Nunes Marques convidou todo o Congresso para posse no TSE
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, appointed to the STF by Jair Bolsonaro in 2020, assumes the presidency of the TSE this Tuesday (12) and has invited all 594 members of Congress and the six living former presidents, including Bolsonaro and Fernando Collor, who are under house arrest and require STF authorization to attend. President Lula (PT) is expected to be present. Nunes Marques’ priority at the Electoral Justice is to combat the improper use of artificial intelligence in campaigns, including setting deadlines for big tech firms to comply with regulations and meet with TSE representatives.

item.title: STF deve validar Lei da Dosimetria mesmo após suspensão por Moraes
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes, rapporteur of the cases related to the January 8 acts, has temporarily suspended the application of the Dosimetry Law for the accused until the matter is judged by the STF plenary. Following opinions from the PGR and AGU, Moraes should schedule the issue for deliberation by all justices. Court interlocutors believe the Supreme Court should uphold the law, as the sentencing guidelines were set by Congress, respecting the separation of powers.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro mira Lei da Dosimetria apesar de indefinição no STF
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro is preparing a request to the STF to apply the Dosimetry Law, which could reduce his sentence from 27 years and 3 months to 19 years and 7 months, allowing progression to semi-open regime in under three years. The law unifies the crimes of coup d'état and violent abolition of the democratic state for sentencing purposes and eases prison regime progression. Its application is currently suspended by a preliminary injunction from Minister Alexandre de Moraes, pending the STF plenary's ruling on its constitutionality.

item.title: Dino derruba censura a reportagem sobre inelegibilidade de Deltan Dallagnol
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino overturned a Paraná Electoral Court order to remove a report on Deltan Dallagnol's ineligibility, ruling that the publication merely reported true facts and that the censorship violated press freedom. He also annulled the BRL 5,000 fine against the Mareli Martins portal, stating that electoral courts cannot impose technical-legal standards incompatible with journalistic activity.

item.title: Nunes Marques convida Jair Bolsonaro para posse na presidência do TSE
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques invited former President Jair Bolsonaro to his inauguration as president of the TSE, scheduled for May 12, 2026, despite Bolsonaro being under house arrest. The invitation follows a judicial protocol of inviting current and former presidents, with Lula also invited. Bolsonaro would need authorization from Justice Alexandre de Moraes to attend, as he is serving a 27-year-and-3-month sentence for electoral crimes.
